description:
Each tracked artifact in the eighteen field-dispatch `dev/active/` entries listed below present at commit `7641561a9` receives one manifest row with ownership evidence, code consumers and a disposition, so regrouping and archival act only on defensible ownership.

## Background

Ownership is admissible only from an existing tracker document reference, an unambiguous issue identifier in the path or content, or unique `jit:<short-id>` commit provenance; an artifact without admissible evidence is unassociated and goes to `dev/archive/legacy/<original-relative-path>`. `dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` Appendix A gives the 2026-10-01 entry classification (rows whose top epic includes 6dc81018) and the method used to derive it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The manifest holds one row per tracked file in the frozen entry list below (the eighteen field-dispatch `dev/active/` entries listed below present at commit `7641561a9`), with owner or association evidence, owning top-level epic, bundle relationships and disposition.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every ownership claim cites an admissible evidence class; rows without admissible evidence carry the legacy-archive disposition.
- [hard] REQ-03: Entries shared by several epics record every owner and the destination chosen by the multi-owner rule.
- [hard] REQ-04: Each entry whose path a non-comment consumer reads or checks (production code, tests, scripts, measurement tooling, relative Cargo paths or configuration) is marked code-pinned and records every such consumer by file and line, and each digest-pinned machine input in the entry is marked.
- [hard] REQ-05: The progress checker reports the shard's rows schema-valid with every source assertion passing.

## Notes

Frozen entry list: `1ac74567`, `220cab0b`, `2a85f728`, `34d85cb9`, `389aa4de`, `3fa7c9d0`, `50b47eae`, `6dc81018-field-capability-dispatch`, `7d7c647c`, `7d824b2f`, `9162956b`, `972e2b88`, `a83583e0`, `dbd8787d`, `e6ea0dde`, `eaae1b56`, `eb9b324c`, `fc976a80`. Entries created after commit `7641561a9` are outside this migration; the `@/inv/active-document-layout` invariant governs them at creation. The code-consumer scan (`dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/dev-path-code-consumers.md`) already identifies these entries as code-pinned: a83583e0 and dbd8787d.
